+  Hold if `k1 > 0.020` (gross drift). Known-good pooled values: 0.0026–0.0050
+  (worst single step 0.0105, TP2 step 0); lossy-state screens pool at
+  0.0067–0.0089 — elevated, but this gate alone is not the separator.
+- Typical-token broadening `p90(|Δ|)`. Exact-arithmetic engine changes
+  (tensor parallelism, paging, chunking, attention-backend swaps) leave most
+  tokens agreeing to rounding: pooled `p90(|Δ|) ≤ 0.031` and median
+  `|Δ| ≈ 5–8e-6` for prod/quiet/TP2/deterministic screens. Lossy cache/state
+  quantization perturbs *typical* tokens everywhere, not just a tail:
+  KV-FP8 (both formats) and int8 SSM-checkpoint screens pool at
+  `p90(|Δ|) > 0.048`. The separation survives 16-prompt × 3-step subsampling
+  (bootstrap: exact-family 97.5th pct ≤ 0.045, lossy-family 2.5th pct ≥ 0.052).
+  `--sglang-mamba-ssm-dtype float16` pools at `p90 = 0.030` with good-like
+  median — its fp32→fp16 state rounding does not broaden typical-token
+  fidelity on this recipe, so it passes; its only elevation is signed KL on
+  one long-context prompt set (pooled 0.0067).
- Support/honesty identity `E_q[exp(Δ)] = Σ_x p(x)` over q's support = 1 for
